**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared downstream consequences of disruptions in distinct but interconnected metabolic pathways (fatty acid metabolism and peroxisomal function) could reveal novel therapeutic targets for broader classes of metabolic disorders. For instance, strategies to manage toxic metabolite accumulation or support cellular detoxification processes might be applicable to both conditions.
